## Activity

During June 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 233 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained throughout the month apart from routine leave. The site continued to provide scheduled imaging activity, and the available records indicate that sessions were completed without any reported operational disruption.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading in most cases. There were 4 ungradable captures, and the ungradable rate was 1.7. These results identify a small proportion of images that could not be graded and should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. Staff should maintain the established capture process and address any recurring issues through normal local arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 68 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 5 days. This provides the main measure of turnaround for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings. Overall, the site completed its planned work during June 2024, with referable outcomes recorded and grading activity undertaken within the reported median lag.
